name: Pramipex 0.25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIPEX 0.25MG TABLET

Pramipex 0.25 mg Tablet contains Pramipexole, a medicine that supports the balance of natural brain chemicals involved in movement and coordination. It is often recommended for individuals experiencing stiffness, tremors, or difficulty with smooth body movements, helping them manage daily activities more comfortably. This tablet is particularly useful for patients whose condition involves dopamine imbalance in the brain, which affects motor control and overall mobility.

The tablet works by stimulating dopamine receptors, which helps improve body movement, coordination, and in some cases, sleep-related symptoms linked to movement disorders. Clinical studies suggest that gradual dose titration helps patients adjust to the medicine while minimizing side effects such as dizziness or drowsiness. Pramipex 0.25 mg Tablet is suitable for adults under medical guidance, while caution is advised in elderly patients, those with kidney or liver disorders, and patients with heart or lung conditions. It is not recommended for children or adolescents under 18 years of age.

The tablet should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional. It can be taken with or without food, preferably at the same time every day. Patients are advised not to double the dose if a tablet is missed. Overdose can cause nausea, vomiting, confusion, hallucinations, restlessness, or low blood pressure. Regular monitoring by a doctor ensures optimal dosage adjustment, especially in patients with kidney or liver conditions.

It may cause drowsiness, sudden sleep episodes, dizziness, or hallucinations, so driving or operating machinery is not recommended after taking it. Patients should avoid alcohol consumption, which can worsen sleepiness. The medicine is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding, as it may affect the foetus or pass into breast milk. Common side effects include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and mild sleepiness, which often improve with continued use. Patients should consult their doctor if any unusual or severe symptoms occur.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIPEX 0.25MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIPEX 0.25MG TABLET Works
Pramipex 0.25 mg Mechanism of Action

Pramipex 0.25 mg Tablet works by stimulating dopamine receptors in the brain, particularly the D2 and D3 receptors, which are involved in regulating movement and coordination. Dopamine is a natural chemical responsible for smooth and controlled muscle activity. In conditions like Parkinson’s disease, dopamine levels are lower than normal, leading to stiffness, tremors, and slow movements.

By activating these receptors, Pramipex helps enhance dopamine signalling, supporting smoother and more coordinated body movements. This action can also influence certain neurological pathways linked to motor control, sleep regulation, and mood stability. The medication’s gradual dose titration ensures that patients experience benefits while minimizing side effects such as dizziness, sleepiness, or hallucinations.

introduction:
Introduction About PACITANE 2MG TABLET

Pacitane 2mg Tablet is a commonly prescribed medicine containing Trihexyphenidyl, which belongs to the class of anticholinergic agents. It is often considered in situations where individuals experience involuntary body movements, muscle stiffness, or tremors, either due to certain neurological conditions or as side effects of psychiatric medications. Pacitane helps by restoring the balance of specific brain chemicals involved in motor control, offering support in managing physical discomforts that interfere with daily movement and coordination.

Pacitane 2mg is usually recommended for patients dealing with extrapyramidal symptoms such as rigidity, spasms, or tremors associated with Parkinsonism or due to certain antipsychotic therapies. It may also be beneficial in helping users improve body coordination and reduce stiffness caused by nervous system imbalances. The medicine is typically taken once or twice a day, preferably at the same time each day, and may be taken with or without meals, depending on individual tolerance. Taking it after food may help reduce the chances of stomach discomfort.

While taking Pacitane 2mg, patients are advised to follow a fixed dosing schedule and avoid abrupt discontinuation unless guided by a healthcare provider. Common precautions include staying hydrated, especially in hot weather, and being cautious during activities like driving, due to the possibility of drowsiness or blurred vision. Individuals with glaucoma, urinary retention, or certain heart conditions should inform their doctor before using this medicine. Monitoring is also important if taken alongside other neurological or psychiatric medications.

Use of Pacitane 2mg in pregnancy and breastfeeding should only be considered under the supervision of a medical professional. Some of the frequently observed side effects may include dry mouth, dizziness, blurred vision, or mild constipation. If these symptoms persist or worsen, a healthcare provider should be consulted for advice. This medicine is part of a carefully managed care plan, and patients are encouraged to maintain good hydration, a balanced diet, and a consistent physical activity routine to support better results during its use.

mechanismOfAction:
How PACITANE 2MG TABLET Works
Pacitane 2mg Mechanism of Action

Pacitane 2mg contains Trihexyphenidyl, which belongs to a class of medicines called anticholinergics. It works by blocking the action of a natural chemical called acetylcholine in the brain. Acetylcholine plays a key role in regulating muscle movement. By reducing its effect, Pacitane helps restore the balance between brain chemicals, supporting smoother and more controlled muscle activity.

 Role of Pacitane 2mg in Muscle Control

Pacitane 2mg is often included in care plans where individuals experience muscle stiffness, spasms, or tremors, particularly due to certain neurological conditions or medication effects. It supports muscle control by relaxing overly tense muscles and minimizing involuntary movements. This can lead to improved mobility and more coordinated motor function during daily activities.

 Pacitane Effect on Nerve Signals and Coordination

Pacitane 2mg influences how nerve signals are transmitted in the brain and spinal cord. By regulating these signals, it helps reduce erratic or uncoordinated muscle responses. As a result, users may notice better movement coordination, balance, and reduced shakiness. This effect can be especially useful in managing symptoms related to neuromuscular imbalances.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNDOPA PLUS TABLET
What is Syndopa Plus Tablet?

Syndopa Plus Tablet is a medication used primarily for the management of Parkinson's disease. It contains a combination of two active ingredients, levodopa and carbidopa which help control the symptoms of Parkinson’s disease by replenishing dopamine in the brain.

Syndopa Plus tablet is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and stomach discomfort. It is usually prescribed as one tab 3-4 times/day. However, your doctor will adjust the dose according to your age, and health condition.

Before taking Syndopa Plus Tablet, inform your doctor if you have any history of heart disease, kidney problems, or liver disease. Avoid alcohol while taking this medication as it may increase the risk of side effects. Syndopa Plus is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women without medical advice.

The most common side effects of Syndopa Plus Tablet are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, muscle cramps, and fatigue. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How SYNDOPA PLUS TABLET Works

When you have Parkinson’s disease, your brain doesn’t make enough dopamine, a chemical that helps control your movements. This lack of dopamine leads to symptoms like shaking, stiffness, and difficulty moving.

Syndopa Plus Tablet contains two medicines, Levodopa and Carbidopa, that work together to help you move better:

Levodopa: This gets converted into dopamine in your brain, replacing the dopamine your body is missing. This helps reduce symptoms like tremors, stiffness, and slowness, so your body moves more smoothly.
Carbidopa: This helps levodopa reach your brain without being broken down too early in your body. It also reduces side effects like nausea, making the treatment easier to tolerate.

Together, these medicines help restore your brain's dopamine levels, improving your ability to move and making daily activities like walking, eating, or writing easier and more manageable.

How Does Syndopa Plus Improve motor skills in Parkinson’s?
By replenishing dopamine levels in the brain, Syndopa Plus helps improve coordination, reduce tremors, and relieve muscle stiffness.
This results in smoother, more controlled movements, allowing patients to perform daily activities like walking, writing, or eating with greater ease.

Regular use of Syndopa Plus, as prescribed by a doctor, is a cornerstone in managing motor symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.

usageDetails:
How to use SYNDOPA PLUS TABLET

Syndopa Plus is a prescription medication which needs to be taken under medical supervision. Care-takers must strictly follow the instructions provided by the doctor to ensure good results.

How To Take Syndopa Plus Tablet?
Swallow the tablet with a glass of water, preferably with food to minimize nausea.
Take it at the same time every day as prescribed by your doctor.
Try to take the last dose of the day several hours before bedtime to avoid sleep disturbances or vivid dreams
Dosage and Administration of Syndopa Plus Tablet:
Your doctor will determine the exact dose based on your condition and response to treatment.
Usually, the prescribed dosage is one tablet 3-4 times a day.
Do not stop taking the medicine abruptly without consulting your doctor, as it may cause stiff muscles, high temperature (fever) and mental changes.
Can I adjust my dose of Syndopa Plus?
No, do not adjust your dose on your own. Always follow your doctor’s instructions for any changes to avoid side effects or reduced effectiveness.
If your symptoms worsen, consult your doctor for a possible dose adjustment.
What happens if I miss a dose of Syndopa Plus?
Take the missed dose as soon as you remember.
If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed one and continue with your regular schedule. Never double the dose to catch up.
Syndopa Plus: Overdosage Instructions:
If you suspect an overdose, contact your doctor or nearest emergency center immediately.
Symptoms of overdose may include confusion, irregular heartbeat, or severe nausea, and medical attention is crucial.

Effective Symptom Management: Syndopa Plus is considered safe for long-term use when taken as prescribed, helping manage Parkinson’s symptoms like tremors, stiffness, and slowness of movement effectively over time.

Risk of Side Effects: Long-term use may lead to side effects like involuntary movements (dyskinesia) or fluctuations in symptom control (on-off phenomena). Regular monitoring by your doctor can help manage these issues.
Periodic Dose Adjustments: Over time, your body may require dose adjustments to maintain effectiveness and minimize side effects. Regular follow-ups with your healthcare provider are essential.

Always discuss any concerns about long-term use with your doctor to ensure the therapy remains safe and effective for your condition.

warnings.details: There is no adequate clinical trial information regarding the use of Levodopa+carbidopa in pregnant women. Available animal studies indicate that levodopa can pass through the placenta and reach the growing offspring. A risk to the growing baby cannot be excluded. Therefore, Syndopa Plus will be prescribed in pregnant women only if the benefits overweigh the risk to the growing fetus.
Clinical studies have shown that levodopa can pass through breast milk. Therefore, Syndopa Plus should be used in breastfeeding only if it is considered extremely necessary.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines, as Syndopa plus tablet may cause sudden sleep attacks or can make you feel sleepy.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking Syndopa plus, as it could make you feel dizzier or drowsier.

Syndopa Plus Tablet should be taken with caution in patients who have or had any kidney impairment. Proper dosage adjustments and careful monitoring are needed in such patients. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing kidney diseases before taking Syndopa plus as a precaution.

Syndopa Plus Tablet should be taken with caution among patients who have or had any liver impairment. Periodic liver check-ups and dosage adjustments are needed in such patients. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking syndopa plus if you have any pre-existing liver diseases.
Do not take Syndopa plus if you are allergic to Levodopa or Carbidopa or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Syndopa plus should be taken with caution among patients with heart disease (such as previous history of heart attack, heartbeat problems, circulation or breathing problems). Consult your doctor before taking.
Syndopa Plus is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.
Syndopa Plus is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, proper dose adjustment and careful monitoring is required.

Others
Who Should Not Take Syndopa Plus?

Syndopa Plus Tablet is not recommended for use in patients who:

Have skin cancer
Have any unusual moles in the skin
Have narrow-angle glaucoma
Have a severe mental disorder (Ex. severe panic disorder, psychosis, severe depression, bipolar disorder)

Before taking Syndopa Plus Tablet, inform your physician if you:

Have a history of fits
Have ulcer in the stomach
Have any hormonal problems
Have chronic wide-angle glaucoma
Feel sleepy or having sudden sleep attacks (Ex. Narcolepsy)
Are due to have a surgery
Are due to have a blood/urine test

Clinical studies have shown that levodopa can pass through breast milk. Therefore, Syndopa Plus should be used in breastfeeding only if it is considered extremely necessary.

USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines, as Syndopa plus tablet may cause sudden sleep attacks or can make you feel sleepy.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking Syndopa plus, as it could make you feel dizzier or drowsier.  

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

Syndopa Plus Tablet should be taken with caution in patients who have or had any kidney impairment. Proper dosage adjustments and careful monitoring are needed in such patients. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing kidney diseases before taking Syndopa plus as a precaution.

Liver
USE WITH CAUTION

Syndopa Plus Tablet should be taken with caution among patients who have or had any liver impairment. Periodic liver check-ups and dosage adjustments are needed in such patients. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking syndopa plus if you have any pre-existing liver diseases.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take Syndopa plus if you are allergic to Levodopa or Carbidopa or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Heart Disease
USE WITH CAUTION

Syndopa plus should be taken with caution among patients with heart disease (such as previous history of heart attack, heartbeat problems, circulation or breathing problems). Consult your doctor before taking.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

Syndopa Plus is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use In Geriatrics
MONITORING REQUIRED

Syndopa Plus is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, proper dose adjustment and careful monitoring is required.

More Information
Dietary Recommendations for Parkinson’s Disease
Balanced Diet: Include plenty of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, and healthy fats to maintain overall health and energy.
Timing of Protein Intake: Avoid high-protein foods (like meat, eggs, or cheese) around the time you take levodopa-based medicines (like Syndopa Plus), as they can interfere with the drug's absorption.
Hydration: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration and manage constipation, a common issue in Parkinson's patients.
Fiber-Rich Foods: Incorporate foods like oats, beans, and fresh fruits to combat constipation.
Antioxidants: Add foods rich in antioxidants (e.g., berries, nuts, spinach) to protect brain cells from damage.
Lifestyle Changes for Managing Parkinson’s Disease
Stay Active: Engage in regular, gentle exercises like walking, yoga, or tai chi to improve mobility, balance, and flexibility.
Maintain a Routine: Consistent daily routines help reduce anxiety and improve symptom management.
Stress Management: Practice relaxation techniques like deep breathing, meditation, or mindfulness to ease stress and anxiety.
Home Safety: Declutter your living space, install grab bars, and use non-slip mats to prevent falls.
Social Engagement: Stay connected with friends, family, or support groups to combat isolation and boost emotional well-being.
Cognitive and Physical Therapies for Parkinson’s Patients
Physical Therapy:
Helps improve strength, balance, and posture.
Specific exercises focus on walking gait and preventing falls.
Occupational Therapy:
Teaches strategies to manage daily tasks like dressing, eating, or writing despite motor limitations.
Speech Therapy:
Assists with speech clarity and swallowing difficulties, common in advanced stages of Parkinson's.
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT):
Helps manage anxiety, depression, or other emotional challenges caused by Parkinson's.
Brain Training Exercises:
Activities like puzzles, memory games, or learning new skills can stimulate cognitive function and delay mental decline.

These strategies, combined with medical treatment, can significantly improve quality of life for Parkinson’s patients.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNDOPA 110 TABLET

Syndopa 110 is a combination medicine that contains Levodopa and Carbidopa. It is designed to manage dopamine levels in the brain, which play a key role in motor control and coordination. This tablet is often recommended as a part of neurological health support to improve the signs of Parkinsonism.

Levodopa converts to dopamine in the brain, while Carbidopa helps reduce the breakdown of Levodopa before it reaches the brain. This dual action supports more efficient dopamine availability and may assist in improving movement-related functions.

SYNDOPA 110 TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

It is important for caregivers to notice and report doctor immediately that if the patient develops any addictive symptoms like craving for large doses of SYNDOPA 110, unusual behaviour, gambling, excessive eating or spending, an abnormally high sex drive or any other activities that could harm themselves or others.

Try to avoid eating a heavy meal that includes a lot of protein (such as beef, pork, cheese, fish and eggs) while taking SYNDOPA 110, as it may interfere with its absorption.

The common side effects of taking SYNDOPA 110 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abnormal muscle movements, loss of appetite, dry mouth, bitter taste and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How SYNDOPA 110 TABLET Works
How Levodopa and Carbidopa work together?

SYNDOPA 110 effectively controls the signs of parkinsonism, where levodopa acts by converting itself into a substance called dopamine (a chemical messenger that controls body movement) and carbidopa acts by managing the breakdown of levodopa outside the brain, thereby allowing greater proportion of levodopa to enter the brain. Collectively they supplement the brain with sufficient dopamine levels which ultimately results in improving the signs of parkinsonism.

moreInfo:
More Information
Understanding the Action of Dopaminergic Medicines
Dopaminergic medicines, including those with Levodopa and Carbidopa, support the brain’s dopamine levels which is a key chemical that helps regulate movement and coordination
Since dopamine itself cannot cross into the brain, these medicines work by increasing dopamine availability inside the brain, which may assist in improving motor function. Carbidopa helps by managing early breakdown of Levodopa outside the brain, allowing more of it to reach the brain where it is needed
This combination helps the nervous system work more effectively, supporting smoother movement and better control
Understanding Parkinson's Disease and the Role of Dopamine
Parkinson's disease is a neurological condition linked to a reduction of dopamine, a chemical messenger in the brain responsible for controlling movement and coordination
Lower dopamine levels can affect muscle control, leading to symptoms such as stiffness and difficulty with movement

Medications like Syndopa 110 aim to support dopamine availability in the brain, helping the nervous system manage these changes. Understanding the role dopamine plays can help users appreciate how their medication supports everyday function.

introduction:
Introduction About XAFINACT 50MG TABLET

XAFINACT 50MG TABLET contains Safinamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoamine oxidase type B (MAO-B) inhibitors. XAFINACT 50MG TABLET is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease, which is an age-related degenerative brain condition that cause unintended/uncontrollable movements in adults.

XAFINACT 50MG TABLET is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease in mid-late-stage patients when used with Levodopa or in combination with other anti-Parkinson’s disease. 

XAFINACT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Safinamide. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from eye condition (due to albinism, retinal degeneration, uveitis, inherited retinopathy), and/or severe liver problems.

Before taking XAFINACT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or other liver problems (such as mild to moderate hepatic impairment).

XAFINACT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

XAFINACT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking XAFINACT 50MG TABLET are insomnia (sleeplessness), difficulty in performing voluntary movements, feeling sleepy/dizzy/falling, headache, clouding of eye lens, drop in blood pressure (while raising to a standing position), and/or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMANTREL 100MG TABLET Works

Amantadine is known to influence dopamine activity and certain viral replication pathways. This dual mechanism helps support brain signaling and viral defense mechanisms as guided by clinical practice. Its role in neurological wellness and immune engagement makes it a unique component in long-term or seasonal care plans.

What Happens in the Body After Taking Amantrel?
Once ingested, Amantrel 100mg Tablet is absorbed through the gastrointestinal tract and enters the bloodstream. It reaches the brain and influences the levels of dopamine, a key chemical messenger that helps regulate body movement, mood, energy, and attention. This is especially helpful in individuals dealing with neurological conditions where dopamine function is altered.
Amantrel also acts on the N-Methyl-D-Aspartate (NMDA) receptors in the brain, helping to reduce abnormal nerve excitability. This dual mechanism may help ease muscle rigidity, slow movements, and mental fatigue in some patients. People managing Parkinsonism or post-viral fatigue symptoms may experience gradual improvement in body control and alertness over time, especially when combined with other supportive therapies
The body processes Amantrel through the kidneys, which is why dosage may be adjusted for elderly individuals or those with reduced kidney function. Some users may begin to feel its effects within a few hours to a few days, but full impact often develops over 1–2 weeks depending on the individual’s response and dosage plan
It is important to take Amantrel consistently and as advised by a healthcare provider, since its action is closely tied to how it is absorbed and maintained in the body. Sudden changes in dose or stopping without guidance can affect the body’s neurological balance and may lead to unwanted effects.

Understanding Dopamine Support in Parkinson’s Care
Dopamine is a chemical messenger that plays a vital role in coordinating body movement, attention, and emotional responses
In Parkinson’s-related conditions, there is a progressive decrease in the natural production of dopamine in certain areas of the brain. This leads to slowness in movement, muscle stiffness, tremors, and fatigue and symptoms that vary from person to person
Medicines like Amantrel 100mg (Amantadine) and Levodopa combinations are often included in a patient’s plan to support dopamine balance. These medicines work by enhancing the brain’s response to dopamine, boosting its release, or supplementing dopamine-like activity
While Levodopa directly converts to dopamine inside the brain, Amantadine supports this balance by influencing receptors involved in motor control and modulating brain signals that affect fatigue and coordination
Dopamine support is not one-size-fits-all. Depending on a person’s age, stage of condition, kidney function, and other health needs, the selection and dosage of medicines may vary
Incorporating lifestyle steps such as consistent medication timing, gentle physical activity, and adequate hydration can further support overall well-being in people receiving dopamine-modulating support

introduction:
Introduction About BEXOL TABLET

BEXOL TABLET contains Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to the group of medicines called Central Anticholinergics. It is used to improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson’s disease is a long-term brain disorder that causes muscle stiffness, shaking, slow and unsteady movements, difficulty in walking and loss of balance. It happens due to loss of nerve cells at certain regions of brain (basal ganglia) that controls body movements.

BEXOL TABLET can also be used to control abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms) in the body that is caused due to the use of certain medicines.

Trihexyphenidyl is a muscle relaxant. It reduces muscle stiffness and relaxes muscles by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also restores a balance between certain brain chemicals (dopamine and acetylcholine) that controls body movements.

Before taking BEXOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or problems in your prostate gland. You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems before taking BEXOL TABLET as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking BEXOL TABLET if you have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or tardive dyskinesia (unusual movements of face and tongue). Consult your doctor before taking BEXOL TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking BEXOL TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, blurred vision, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About PARKITIDIN TABLET

Parkitidin Tablet contains Amantadine, a dopamine agonist medicine that supports better muscle coordination and movement. It is effective for individuals facing difficulty with walking, gripping, or maintaining body balance. Additionally, Parkitidin helps manage viral infections such as shingles (herpes zoster) and influenza A. This tablet is specially formulated to assist those with movement-related nervous system disorders, including Parkinson’s disease and drug-induced movement symptoms. When taken regularly as directed by healthcare professionals, Parkitidin Tablet may improve daily functioning by promoting smoother, more controlled body movements, helping users regain independence and enhance their quality of life.

Take Parkitidin Tablet exactly as prescribed by your doctor. You may take the tablet with or without food, preferably at the same time every day, to maintain a consistent level of the medicine in your bloodstream. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully regarding the dose and duration of management. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. Complete the full prescribed course of Parkitidin Tablet even if you start feeling better. Do not stop taking this medication suddenly without consulting your healthcare provider, as abrupt discontinuation may cause adverse effects. Maintaining regular use helps support muscle coordination and movement effectively for people with Parkinson’s disease and other movement disorders.

Common side effects of Parkitidin Tablet include nausea, dizziness, insomnia, dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, hallucinations, and balance difficulties. If you experience dizziness, it is important to rise slowly from sitting or lying positions to reduce falls. Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you understand how this medicine affects your focus and coordination. Most side effects are temporary and improve as your body adjusts, but consult your doctor if symptoms persist or worsen.

This medicine may increase the risk of seizures. It is important to inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures or are currently taking any medication for seizure control. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult with their healthcare provider before starting this medicine to ensure it is suitable and safe for their condition. Always follow your doctor’s advice for the safest use of Parkitidin Tablet.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNDOPA CR TABLET

Syndopa CR Tablet is a controlled-release medicine formulated to support individuals living with Parkinson’s disease and related movement disorders. Parkinson’s occurs due to reduced levels of dopamine in the brain, leading to tremors, stiffness, slow body movements, and difficulty with balance. By restoring dopamine activity, it helps improve daily mobility and reduces fluctuations in symptoms, making routine tasks more manageable for patients.

This medicine contains a combination of Levodopa and Carbidopa. Levodopa is converted into dopamine in the brain, directly addressing the chemical deficiency, while Carbidopa prevents its premature breakdown, allowing more levodopa to reach the brain. The controlled-release (CR) formulation ensures a gradual and sustained effect, making it suitable for patients who need steady symptom relief throughout the day. It is generally prescribed for adults, especially those requiring long-term management of Parkinson’s symptoms.

Syndopa CR should be taken exactly as prescribed by the doctor, usually at the same time each day. The tablet must be swallowed whole with water and not crushed or chewed. It can be taken with or just after meals to reduce nausea, though very high-protein foods may interfere with absorption. Patients must attend regular follow-ups so the doctor can adjust the dose according to response. Precautions are essential in people with heart disease, kidney or liver conditions, mental health issues, or a history of low blood pressure.

This medicine is not recommended in pregnancy or breastfeeding unless clearly prescribed by a doctor. Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, and involuntary movements. In rare cases, mood changes, irregular heartbeat, or sudden sleep attacks may occur, requiring medical attention. Patients should avoid alcohol, driving, or operating heavy machines while on treatment. By carefully following dosage instructions and safety advice, Syndopa CR can significantly improve quality of life for people coping with Parkinson’s disease.

mechanismOfAction:
How SYNDOPA CR TABLET Works

Syndopa CR Tablet contains two active ingredients – Levodopa and Carbidopa – that work together to improve movement problems in Parkinson’s disease.

Levodopa is a chemical that gets converted into dopamine in the brain. Dopamine is a natural substance that helps control body movements, but its levels are low in people with Parkinson’s disease. By increasing dopamine, levodopa helps reduce stiffness, tremors, and slow movements.
Carbidopa prevents levodopa from breaking down too early in the bloodstream, ensuring that more levodopa reaches the brain. This enhances the effect of levodopa and reduces side effects like nausea.
The CR (Controlled Release) formulation allows the medicine to be released slowly over time, providing more stable dopamine levels and longer-lasting symptom control.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNDOPA CR 125MG TABLET

Syndopa CR 125mg Tablet is specifically formulated to support individuals experiencing symptoms related to Parkinson’s disease, a neurological condition that affects movement. Parkinson’s symptoms, such as muscle stiffness, tremors, slow movements, and coordination difficulties, arise from reduced dopamine levels in the brain. This medication combines Levodopa, which converts into dopamine to replenish the brain’s supply, and Carbidopa, which prevents premature breakdown of Levodopa, allowing more of it to reach the brain effectively. It is ideal for patients diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease who require improved motor function and reduced symptom fluctuations. 

For optimal results, Syndopa CR 125mg Tablet should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional, preferably on an empty stomach to enhance absorption. The extended-release formulation allows the active ingredients to work steadily throughout the day, reducing the frequency of doses needed and providing a more consistent therapeutic effect. Patients should swallow the tablet whole without crushing or chewing it, and avoid consuming high-protein meals at the time of dose as proteins may interfere with the medicine’s absorption. Consistency in timing and dose is important to maintain symptom control and prevent sudden “off” periods where symptoms may worsen.

Certain precautions are essential when using Syndopa CR 125mg Tablet. Avoid alcohol consumption to prevent increased dizziness or drowsiness. Caution is advised for patients with kidney, liver, or heart conditions, and those with a history of mental health disorders or glaucoma. It is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women, and usage in children under 18 years is generally discouraged. Elderly patients may require dose adjustments and close monitoring to ensure safety and effectiveness. Inform your healthcare provider of your complete medical history before starting the medication, especially if you have a history of seizures, stomach ulcers, or sleep disorders.

Common side effects include nausea, involuntary muscle movements, dry mouth, loss of appetite, and occasional dizziness. Most side effects are mild and manageable, but any severe or persistent symptoms should be promptly reported to a doctor. Following medical advice carefully and attending regular check-ups helps ensure safe use and maximizes the benefits of Syndopa CR 125mg Tablet in managing the challenging symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIPEX 0.5MG TABLET

Pramipex 0.5 mg Tablet contains Pramipexole, a medicine that supports the balance of natural brain chemicals involved in movement and coordination. It is often recommended for individuals experiencing stiffness, tremors, or difficulty with smooth body movements, helping them manage daily activities more comfortably. This tablet is particularly useful for patients whose condition involves dopamine imbalance in the brain, which affects motor control and overall mobility.                      

The tablet works by stimulating dopamine receptors, which helps improve body movement, coordination, and in some cases, sleep-related symptoms linked to movement disorders. Clinical studies suggest that gradual dose titration helps patients adjust to the medicine while minimizing side effects such as dizziness or drowsiness. Pramipex 0.5 mg Tablet is suitable for adults under medical guidance, while caution is advised in elderly patients, those with kidney or liver disorders, and patients with heart or lung conditions. It is not recommended for children or adolescents under 18 years of age.   

The tablet should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional. It can be taken with or without food, preferably at the same time every day. Patients are advised not to double the dose if a tablet is missed. Overdose can cause nausea, vomiting, confusion, hallucinations, restlessness, or low blood pressure. Regular monitoring by a doctor ensures optimal dosage adjustment, especially in patients with kidney or liver conditions.

It may cause drowsiness, sudden sleep episodes, dizziness, or hallucinations, so driving or operating machinery is not recommended after taking it. Patients should avoid alcohol consumption, which can worsen sleepiness. The medicine is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding, as it may affect the foetus or pass into breast milk. Common side effects include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and mild sleepiness, which often improve with continued use. Patients should consult their doctor if any unusual or severe symptoms occur.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIPEX 0.5MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIPEX 0.5MG TABLET Works
Pramipex 0.5 mg Mechanism of Action

Pramipex 0.5 mg Tablet works by stimulating dopamine receptors in the brain, particularly the D2 and D3 receptors, which are involved in regulating movement and coordination. Dopamine is a natural chemical responsible for smooth and controlled muscle activity. In conditions like Parkinson’s disease, dopamine levels are lower than normal, leading to stiffness, tremors, and slow movements.

By activating these receptors, Pramipex helps enhance dopamine signalling, supporting smoother and more coordinated body movements. This action can also influence certain neurological pathways linked to motor control, sleep regulation, and mood stability. The medication’s gradual dose titration ensures that patients experience benefits while minimizing side effects such as dizziness, sleepiness, or hallucinations.

introduction:
Introduction About DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET

DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET contains Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to the group of medicines called Central Anticholinergics. It is used to improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson’s disease is a long-term brain disorder that causes muscle stiffness, shaking, slow and unsteady movements, difficulty in walking and loss of balance. It happens due to loss of nerve cells at certain regions of brain (basal ganglia) that controls body movements.

DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET can also be used to control abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms) in the body that is caused due to the use of certain medicines.

Trihexyphenidyl is a muscle relaxant. It reduces muscle stiffness and relaxes muscles by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also restores a balance between certain brain chemicals (dopamine and acetylcholine) that controls body movements.

Before taking DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or problems in your prostate gland. You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems before taking DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET if you have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or tardive dyskinesia (unusual movements of face and tongue). Consult your doctor before taking DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, blurred vision, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage drug-induced abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms)

DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET is an anticholinergic medicine with muscle relaxing properties. It reduces muscle stiffness and improves muscle control by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also regulates the release of a brain chemical called dopamine that regulates proper body movements and coordination. As a result, it reduces abnormal muscle movements associated with Parkinson’s disease and with the use of certain medicines.

Take DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine. It must be taken with or just before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take DYSKINIL 2MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as advised by your doctor without any interruption to achieve maximum benefits.

name: Pexopram 0.25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET

PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET Works

PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).
usageDetails:
How to use PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET

Take PEXOPRAM 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Modin 2.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MODIN 2.5MG TABLET

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET contains Procyclidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics. It is used to relieve and manage the signs of Parkinson's disease such as stiff muscles, paralysis, shaking of hands (tremors), trouble talking, writing and walking, producing too much saliva and dribbling, sweating, uncontrolled eye movements and depression.

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET is also used to control extrapyramidal effects caused by certain medicines used to manage mental health conditions, which might include restlessness and unusual head and body movements.

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have tardive dyskinesia (uncontrolled movements of the head or tongue). Consult your doctor before taking it.

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease, high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyrotoxicosis. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Inform your doctor if you are breastfeeding before taking it.

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. MODIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking MODIN 2.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty urinating. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage and relieve signs of Parkinson’s disease
To control extrapyramidal effects caused by certain medicines
usesDetails:

To manage and relieve signs of Parkinson’s disease

mechanismOfAction:
How MODIN 2.5MG TABLET Works

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET works by stopping a substance called acetylcholine in the brain and helps to reduce the symptoms of Parkinson's disease such as muscle stiffness, sweating, production of saliva and improves walking ability in people with Parkinson’s disease and also helps to controls Parkinson-like side effects caused by certain medicines used to manage mental health conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use MODIN 2.5MG TABLET

Take MODIN 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take it with food to reduce nausea. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MODIN 2.5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop. Otherwise, your symptoms may return.

Do not take MODIN 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Procyclidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have tardive dyskinesia (uncontrolled movements of the head or tongue)

Before taking MODIN 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have trouble passing urine (urinary retention) due to an enlarged prostate gland

Have narrow angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye) or family history of glaucoma or have a higher chance to get glaucoma
Have a mental health condition
Have constipation

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

MODIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor might carefully monitor your dose to manage any side effects. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET

CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET contains cabergoline, which belongs to the group of medicines called dopamine agonists. Dopamine is a chemical produced naturally in the body that helps transmit messages to the brain. Cabergoline works by blocking the release of prolactin hormone in the brain and controlling symptoms associated with hormonal disturbances.

CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, stiff and inflamed heart valves (cardiac valvulopathy) and uncontrolled high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pain in the chest while breathing, fluid in the lungs, inflammation or infection of the lungs, reduced liver function, kidney problems, cardiovascular diseases, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children under 16 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET are drowsiness, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo, stomach pain, indigestion, inflamed stomach lining, fatigue, lack of bodily strength, weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Take CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

It can be taken with or after food to help reduce feelings of nausea or vomiting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. You should not stop taking CABGOLIN 0.25MG TABLET until your doctor tells you.

introduction:
Introduction About AMANTEX 100MG TABLET

AMANTEX 100MG TABLET contains Amantadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists or Anti-viral agents. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease (a progressive nervous disease that causes tremor, muscular rigidity and slow imprecise movements), and manages various strains of influenza A virus (caused by the multiplication of the virus inside the body).

It is also used to manage shingles (herpes zoster) to reduce pain, which is a reactivation of chickenpox virus causing a painful rash and drug-induced extrapyramidal reactions (such as involuntary muscle contraction, tremors, stiff muscles, and involuntary facial movements caused by antipsychotics and other drugs).

Before taking AMANTEX 100MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver or heart (which may cause shortness of breath or ankle swelling), any mental illness like schizophrenia (mental disorder) or dementia (memory loss) and glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes).

AMANTEX 100MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken while you are pregnant or breast feeding. AMANTEX 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in newborn and infants (below 1 year of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (who are 65 years of age or older). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking AMANTEX 100MG TABLET are loss of appetite, tiredness, dryness in the mouth, constipation and nausea or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMANTEX 100MG TABLET Works

AMANTEX 100MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist and an anti-viral agent that manages Parkinson's disease and certain type of viral infections. As a dopamine agonist, it works by increasing the amount of dopamine, a chemical messenger in the brain which regulates the body movements. As an antiviral agent, it works against viruses to prevent their growth and multiplication. It also stops the viruses from releasing infectious chemicals (viral nucleic acid) to enter into the body which protects from influenza infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET

ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET contains Safinamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoamine oxidase type B (MAO-B) inhibitors. ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease, which is an age-related degenerative brain condition that cause unintended/uncontrollable movements in adults.

ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease in mid-late-stage patients when used with Levodopa or in combination with other anti-Parkinson’s disease. 

ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Safinamide. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from eye condition (due to albinism, retinal degeneration, uveitis, inherited retinopathy), and/or severe liver problems.

Before taking ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or other liver problems (such as mild to moderate hepatic impairment).

ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET are insomnia (sleeplessness), difficulty in performing voluntary movements, feeling sleepy/dizzy/falling, headache, clouding of eye lens, drop in blood pressure (while raising to a standing position), and/or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Manage Parkinson’s disease in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET
Manage Parkinson’s disease in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET Works

ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET works by increasing the level of a substance called dopamine (responsible for the control of movement) in the brain which generally occurs in low levels in patient affected with Parkinson’s disease.
usageDetails:
How to use ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET

Take ZAFIMOVE 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET

SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa, Levodopa and Entacapone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parkinsonian drugs. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson's disease is a disorder affecting the brain, causing unintended or uncontrollable movements, such as shaking, stiffness and difficulty along with balance and coordination. It usually starts gradually and worsens over time. As the disease progresses, people have difficulty walking and talking.

While taking SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET for the long term, your doctor may suggest some regular laboratory tests. SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, narrow-angle glaucoma, adrenal gland tumour, history of neuroleptic malignant syndrome and non-traumatic rhabdomyolysis.

Before taking SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other disease of the lungs, kidney, heart and mental health diseases. SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding, children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The common side effects of SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET are uncontrolled movements, nausea, reddish-brown, discoloured urine, diarrhoea and muscle pain. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET
Manage Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET Works

SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET is a combination of Levodopa which gets converted to dopamine, a chemical messenger that controls movement in the brain. Carbidopa manages the breakdown of Levodopa by allowing it to enter the brain for increased dopamine levels and Entacapone maintains the level of levodopa in the blood. All these collective actions provide greater relief from the symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.

Take SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decided by your doctor, depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SYNCAPONE 50MG TABLET without your doctor’s advice.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIPEX 1MG TABLET

PRAMIPEX 1MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIPEX 1MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIPEX 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

name: Ecitane Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ECITANE TABLET

ECITANE TABLET contains Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to the group of medicines called Central Anticholinergics. It is used to improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson’s disease is a long-term brain disorder that causes muscle stiffness, shaking, slow and unsteady movements, difficulty in walking and loss of balance. It happens due to loss of nerve cells at certain regions of brain (basal ganglia) that controls body movements.

ECITANE TABLET can also be used to control abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms) in the body that is caused due to the use of certain medicines.

Trihexyphenidyl is a muscle relaxant. It reduces muscle stiffness and relaxes muscles by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also restores a balance between certain brain chemicals (dopamine and acetylcholine) that controls body movements.

Before taking ECITANE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or problems in your prostate gland. You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems before taking ECITANE TABLET as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking ECITANE TABLET if you have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or tardive dyskinesia (unusual movements of face and tongue). Consult your doctor before taking ECITANE TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ECITANE TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, blurred vision, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Reduce muscle stiffness and improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease
Manage drug-induced abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ECITANE TABLET

It is used to:

Reduce muscle stiffness and improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease
Manage drug-induced abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms)
mechanismOfAction:
How ECITANE TABLET Works

ECITANE TABLET is an anticholinergic medicine with muscle relaxing properties. It reduces muscle stiffness and improves muscle control by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also regulates the release of a brain chemical called dopamine that regulates proper body movements and coordination. As a result, it reduces abnormal muscle movements associated with Parkinson’s disease and with the use of certain medicines.
usageDetails:
How to use ECITANE TABLET

Take ECITANE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ECITANE TABLET with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine. It must be taken with or just before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ECITANE TABLET for the stipulated duration as advised by your doctor without any interruption to achieve maximum benefits.

name: CB Lin 0.25mg Tablet 2'S
introduction:
Introduction About CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET

CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET contains cabergoline, which belongs to the group of medicines called dopamine agonists. Dopamine is a chemical produced naturally in the body that helps transmit messages to the brain. Cabergoline works by blocking the release of prolactin hormone in the brain and controlling symptoms associated with hormonal disturbances.

CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, stiff and inflamed heart valves (cardiac valvulopathy) and uncontrolled high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pain in the chest while breathing, fluid in the lungs, inflammation or infection of the lungs, reduced liver function, kidney problems, cardiovascular diseases, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children under 16 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET are drowsiness, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo, stomach pain, indigestion, inflamed stomach lining, fatigue, lack of bodily strength, weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Blocks the release of prolactin hormone in the brain
usesDetails:

Blocks the release of prolactin hormone in the brain
mechanismOfAction:
How CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET Works

CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET works by decreasing the amount of a hormone called prolactin (a hormone that is responsible for milk production and breast tissue development).
usageDetails:
How to use CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET

Take CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

It can be taken with or after food to help reduce feelings of nausea or vomiting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. You should not stop taking CB LIN 0.25MG TABLET until your doctor tells you.

introduction:
Introduction About ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET

ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

ROPARK XL 1MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About XAFINACT 100MG TABLET

XAFINACT 100MG TABLET contains Safinamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoamine oxidase type B (MAO-B) inhibitors. XAFINACT 100MG TABLET is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease, which is an age-related degenerative brain condition that cause unintended/uncontrollable movements in adults.

XAFINACT 100MG TABLET is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease in mid-late-stage patients when used with Levodopa or in combination with other anti-Parkinson’s disease. 

XAFINACT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Safinamide. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from eye condition (due to albinism, retinal degeneration, uveitis, inherited retinopathy), and/or severe liver problems.

Before taking XAFINACT 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or other liver problems (such as mild to moderate hepatic impairment).

XAFINACT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

XAFINACT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking XAFINACT 100MG TABLET are insomnia (sleeplessness), difficulty in performing voluntary movements, feeling sleepy/dizzy/falling, headache, clouding of eye lens, drop in blood pressure (while raising to a standing position), and/or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ROPARK 2MG TABLET

ROPARK 2MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPARK 2MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPARK 2MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPARK 2MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPARK 2MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPARK 2MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How ROPARK 2MG TABLET Works

ROPARK 2MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.
usageDetails:

Take ROPARK 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIRISE 0.25MG TABLET

PRAMIRISE 0.25MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIRISE 0.25MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIRISE 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIRISE 0.25MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:

Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIRISE 0.25MG TABLET Works

PRAMIRISE 0.25MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

introduction:
Introduction About TIDOMET FORTE TABLET

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa and Levodopa which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparkinsonian drugs. It is used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism. Parkinsonism is a long-term illness caused due to loss of nerve cells in the part of the brain which is responsible for producing dopamine. Dopamine is a chemical messenger that controls body balance and movements.

Symptoms of parkinsonism include slow and unsteady movements, muscle tightness, shaking or trembling, difficulty in walking, balance and coordination.

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET must be used with caution among patients having any form of glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes), as it can lead to further damage to the eye. TIDOMET FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

It is important for caregivers to notice and report doctor immediately that if the patient develops any addictive symptoms like craving for large doses of TIDOMET FORTE TABLET, unusual behavior, gambling, excessive eating or spending, an abnormally high sex drive or any other activities that could harm themselves or others.

Try to avoid eating a heavy meal that includes a lot of protein (such as beef, pork, cheese, fish and eggs) while taking TIDOMET FORTE TABLET, as it may interfere with its absorption.

The common side effects of taking TIDOMET FORTE TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abnormal muscle movements, loss of appetite, dry mouth, bitter taste and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism
usesDetails:
Uses Of TIDOMET FORTE TABLET
Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism
mechanismOfAction:
How TIDOMET FORTE TABLET Works

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET effectively controls the signs of parkinsonism, where levodopa acts by converting itself into a substance called dopamine (a chemical messenger that controls body movement) and carbidopa acts by managing the breakdown of levodopa outside the brain, thereby allowing greater proportion of levodopa to enter the brain. Collectively they supplement the brain with sufficient dopamine levels which ultimately results in improving the signs of parkinsonism.
usageDetails:
How to use TIDOMET FORTE TABLET

Take TIDOMET FORTE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Continue to take TIDOMET FORTE TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop because sudden withdrawal of TIDOMET FORTE TABLET can cause symptoms like mental changes, fever and muscle tightness.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TIDOMET FORTE TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET should be taken with caution among patients who have or had any liver diseases in the past. Consult your doctor before taking it.

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET should be taken with caution among patients with heart disease (such as previous history of heart attack, heartbeat problems, circulation or breathing problems). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who:

Have ever had any forms of skin cancer
Have any unusual moles in the skin that has not yet been examined by the doctor
Have narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
Have a severe mental disorder (Ex. severe panic disorder, psychosis, severe depression, bipolar disorder)

Before taking TIDOMET FORTE TABLET, inform your physician if you:

Have a history of fits (epilepsy)
Have had an ulcer in the stomach
Have vomited blood
Have any hormonal problems
Have had depression or any other similar mental problems
Have chronic wide-angle glaucoma (a painless eye condition that can affect your vision)
Feel sleepy or having sudden sleep attacks (Ex. Narcolepsy)
Are due to have a surgery
Are due to have a blood/urine test

Use in pediatrics:

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

TIDOMET FORTE TABLET is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, proper dose adjustment and careful monitoring is required in such patients.

Introduction About SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET

SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa, Levodopa and Entacapone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parkinsonian drugs. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson's disease is a disorder affecting the brain, causing unintended or uncontrollable movements, such as shaking, stiffness and difficulty along with balance and coordination. It usually starts gradually and worsens over time. As the disease progresses, people have difficulty walking and talking.

While taking SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET for the long term, your doctor may suggest some regular laboratory tests. SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, narrow-angle glaucoma, adrenal gland tumour, history of neuroleptic malignant syndrome and non-traumatic rhabdomyolysis.

Before taking SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other disease of the lungs, kidney, heart and mental health diseases. SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding, children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The common side effects of SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET are uncontrolled movements, nausea, reddish-brown, discoloured urine, diarrhoea and muscle pain. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.

Manage Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET Works

SYNCAPONE 150MG TABLET is a combination of Levodopa which gets converted to dopamine, a chemical messenger that controls movement in the brain. Carbidopa manages the breakdown of Levodopa by allowing it to enter the brain for increased dopamine levels and Entacapone maintains the level of levodopa in the blood. All these collective actions provide greater relief from the symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIROL SR 3.15MG TABLET

PRAMIROL SR 3.15MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIROL SR 3.15MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIROL SR 3.15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET

MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET contains Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to the group of medicines called Central Anticholinergics. It is used to improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson’s disease is a long-term brain disorder that causes muscle stiffness, shaking, slow and unsteady movements, difficulty in walking and loss of balance. It happens due to loss of nerve cells at certain regions of brain (basal ganglia) that controls body movements.

MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET can also be used to control abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms) in the body that is caused due to the use of certain medicines.

Trihexyphenidyl is a muscle relaxant. It reduces muscle stiffness and relaxes muscles by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also restores a balance between certain brain chemicals (dopamine and acetylcholine) that controls body movements.

Before taking MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or problems in your prostate gland. You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems before taking MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET if you have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or tardive dyskinesia (unusual movements of face and tongue). Consult your doctor before taking MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, blurred vision, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET Works

MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET is an anticholinergic medicine with muscle relaxing properties. It reduces muscle stiffness and improves muscle control by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also regulates the release of a brain chemical called dopamine that regulates proper body movements and coordination. As a result, it reduces abnormal muscle movements associated with Parkinson’s disease and with the use of certain medicines.
