Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take MOVAHEXY 5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as advised by your doctor without any interruption to achieve maximum benefits.

introduction:
Introduction About ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET

ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa, Levodopa and Entacapone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parkinsonian drugs. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson's disease is a disorder affecting the brain, causing unintended or uncontrollable movements, such as shaking, stiffness and difficulty along with balance and coordination. It usually starts gradually and worsens over time. As the disease progresses, people have difficulty walking and talking.

While taking ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET for the long term, your doctor may suggest some regular laboratory tests. ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, narrow-angle glaucoma, adrenal gland tumour, history of neuroleptic malignant syndrome and non-traumatic rhabdomyolysis.

Before taking ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other disease of the lungs, kidney, heart and mental health diseases. ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding, children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The common side effects of ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET are uncontrolled movements, nausea, reddish-brown, discoloured urine, diarrhoea and muscle pain. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET
Manage Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET Works

ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET is a combination of Levodopa which gets converted to dopamine, a chemical messenger that controls movement in the brain. Carbidopa manages the breakdown of Levodopa by allowing it to enter the brain for increased dopamine levels and Entacapone maintains the level of levodopa in the blood. All these collective actions provide greater relief from the symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.

How to use ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET

Take ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decided by your doctor, depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENTACOM PLUS 50MG TABLET without your doctor’s advice.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET

SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa, Levodopa and Entacapone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parkinsonian drugs. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson's disease is a disorder affecting the brain, causing unintended or uncontrollable movements, such as shaking, stiffness and difficulty along with balance and coordination. It usually starts gradually and worsens over time. As the disease progresses, people have difficulty walking and talking.

While taking SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET for the long term, your doctor may suggest some regular laboratory tests. SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, narrow-angle glaucoma, adrenal gland tumour, history of neuroleptic malignant syndrome and non-traumatic rhabdomyolysis.

Before taking SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other disease of the lungs, kidney, heart and mental health diseases. SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding, children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The common side effects of SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET are uncontrolled movements, nausea, reddish-brown, discoloured urine, diarrhoea and muscle pain. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:

Manage Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET Works

SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET is a combination of Levodopa which gets converted to dopamine, a chemical messenger that controls movement in the brain. Carbidopa manages the breakdown of Levodopa by allowing it to enter the brain for increased dopamine levels and Entacapone maintains the level of levodopa in the blood. All these collective actions provide greater relief from the symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.

How to use SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET

Take SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decided by your doctor, depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SYNCAPONE 100MG TABLET without your doctor’s advice.

introduction:
Introduction About ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET

ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

ROPARK XL 2MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.

introduction:
Introduction About ROPARK 0.5MG TABLET

ROPARK 0.5MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPARK 0.5MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPARK 0.5MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPARK 0.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPARK 0.5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPARK 0.5MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

name: Pramirol SR 1.05mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET

PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET Works

PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

Take PRAMIROL SR 1.05MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET

PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease

How PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET Works

It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Cimetidine, ranitidine, pantoprazole, antacids (medicines used to manage excess acid and to manage gastric ulcers)
Amantadine, levodopa, benztropine (medicines used to manage parkinson’s disease)
Mexiletine, procainamide, quinidine (medicines used to manage irregular heartbeats
Zidovudine (medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Cisplatin (medicine used to manage various types of cancers)
Quinine (medicines used to manage malaria)
Any medicines that calm you down (sedative effect)
Phenothiazines, butyrophenones, thioxanthenes (medicines used to manage schizophrenia and psychoses)
Metoclopramide (medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Diltiazem, triamterene, verapamil, hydrochlorothiazide (medicines used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases)
Cefadroxil, cefaclor, amoxicillin (medicines used for bacterial infections)
Indomethacin (medicines used to manage pain)
Chlorpropamide (medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus)

Overdosage:

If you miss a dose of PRAMIROL SR 2.1MG TABLET, do not take double dose. If you have accidentally taken too much of this medicine, contact your doctor or nearest hospital immediately for advice. Symptoms of overdosage are vomiting, nausea, agitation, low blood pressure, hallucination, restlessness, confusion.

name: PARKITIDIN ER 129 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET contains Amantadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists or Anti-viral agents. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease (a progressive nervous disease that causes tremor, muscular rigidity and slow imprecise movements), and manages various strains of influenza A virus (caused by the multiplication of the virus inside the body).

It is also used to manage shingles (herpes zoster) to reduce pain, which is a reactivation of chickenpox virus causing a painful rash and drug-induced extrapyramidal reactions (such as involuntary muscle contraction, tremors, stiff muscles, and involuntary facial movements caused by antipsychotics and other drugs).

Before taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver or heart (which may cause shortness of breath or ankle swelling), any mental illness like schizophrenia (mental disorder) or dementia (memory loss) and glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes).

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET is not recommended to be taken while you are pregnant or breast feeding. PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET is not recommended for use in newborn and infants (below 1 year of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (who are 65 years of age or older). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET are loss of appetite, tiredness, dryness in the mouth, constipation and nausea or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET Works

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET is a dopamine agonist and an anti-viral agent that manages Parkinson's disease and certain type of viral infections. As a dopamine agonist, it works by increasing the amount of dopamine, a chemical messenger in the brain which regulates the body movements. As an antiviral agent, it works against viruses to prevent their growth and multiplication. It also stops the viruses from releasing infectious chemicals (viral nucleic acid) to enter into the body which protects from influenza infection.

warnings.details: PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET is not recommended for use while you are pregnant. Consult your doctor before taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET if you are pregnant or planning to have a baby.
PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET is not recommended for use while you are breast feeding as it may pass through breast milk and could harm the baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not drive or use machines after taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET as it may cause side effects such as dizziness or visual disturbances that may affect your ability to drive and use machines. Consult your doctor before taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET.
Do not drink alcohol while taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET as it may cause dizziness, confusion, light headedness and low blood pressure (especially when standing up from sitting or lying position).

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET should not be used in patients with serious kidney disease. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking it.
PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET should be taken with caution if you have any liver disease. Consult with your doctor before taking it.
Do not take PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET if you are allergic to Amantadine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with a history of disease involving the heart and blood vessels or suffering from heart problems or heart failure (which causes shortness of breath or ankle swelling). Consult with your doctor before taking it.

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET is not recommended for use in newborn and infants (below 1 year of age). It is used in children (from 1 to 12 years of age). Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the age and body weight. Consult child’s doctor for advice.

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients who are 65 years of age or older, and your doctor may initiate the management with the lowest effective dose in patients with kidney impairment, heart failure, peripheral oedema (swelling of legs or hands) or low blood pressure (especially when standing up from sitting or lying position). Consult with your doctor before taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET.

Others

PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have convulsions (fits)
Ever had ulcer in the stomach or small intestine

Before taking PARKITIDIN ER 129 TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have any mental illness (such as schizophrenia or dementia)
Have increased eye pressure (glaucoma)

introduction:
Introduction About AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET

AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET contains Amantadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists or Anti-viral agents. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease (a progressive nervous disease that causes tremor, muscular rigidity and slow imprecise movements), and manages various strains of influenza A virus (caused by the multiplication of the virus inside the body).

It is also used to manage shingles (herpes zoster) to reduce pain, which is a reactivation of chickenpox virus causing a painful rash and drug-induced extrapyramidal reactions (such as involuntary muscle contraction, tremors, stiff muscles, and involuntary facial movements caused by antipsychotics and other drugs).

Before taking AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver or heart (which may cause shortness of breath or ankle swelling), any mental illness like schizophrenia (mental disorder) or dementia (memory loss) and glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes).

AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET is not recommended to be taken while you are pregnant or breast feeding. AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET is not recommended for use in newborn and infants (below 1 year of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (who are 65 years of age or older). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET are loss of appetite, tiredness, dryness in the mouth, constipation and nausea or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET Works

AMANTREL ER 129 TABLET is a dopamine agonist and an anti-viral agent that manages Parkinson's disease and certain type of viral infections. As a dopamine agonist, it works by increasing the amount of dopamine, a chemical messenger in the brain which regulates the body movements. As an antiviral agent, it works against viruses to prevent their growth and multiplication. It also stops the viruses from releasing infectious chemicals (viral nucleic acid) to enter into the body which protects from influenza infection.

introduction:
Introduction About SAFION 50 TABLET

SAFION 50 TABLET contains Safinamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoamine oxidase type B (MAO-B) inhibitors. SAFION 50 TABLET is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease, which is an age-related degenerative brain condition that cause unintended/uncontrollable movements in adults.

SAFION 50 TABLET is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease in mid-late-stage patients when used with Levodopa or in combination with other anti-Parkinson’s disease. 

SAFION 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Safinamide. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from eye condition (due to albinism, retinal degeneration, uveitis, inherited retinopathy), and/or severe liver problems.

Before taking SAFION 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or other liver problems (such as mild to moderate hepatic impairment).

SAFION 50 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

SAFION 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking SAFION 50 TABLET are insomnia (sleeplessness), difficulty in performing voluntary movements, feeling sleepy/dizzy/falling, headache, clouding of eye lens, drop in blood pressure (while raising to a standing position), and/or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIROL 0.5MG TABLET

PRAMIROL 0.5MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIROL 0.5MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIROL 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIROL 0.5MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease

How PRAMIROL 0.5MG TABLET Works

PRAMIROL 0.5MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

introduction:
Introduction About ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET

ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

ROPARIL 0.5MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.

introduction:
Introduction About TRISPER 2MG TABLET

TRISPER 2MG TABLET is a combination of Risperidone and Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to a group of medicines called Atypical antipsychotics and Anticholinergics, respectively. It is used to manage schizophrenia, and acute manic episodes in affected individuals.  Schizophrenia is a serious mental disorder that affects a person's ability to think, feel/behave clearly. Acute manic episode is a manic phase of bipolar I disorder which is defined as an extremely unstable or irritable mood along with excess activity or energy level in affected individuals.

[GBKEYWORD] is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Risperidone, and/or Trihexyphenidyl. Before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a stroke, involuntary movements of the tongue, mouth and face, Parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), dementia ( loss of cognitive functioning such as thinking, remembering, and reasoning), epilepsy, myasthenia gravis ( muscle weakness), tardive dyskinesia (neurological disorder), heart, kidney, and/or liver problems.

TRISPER 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly necessary. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The medicine is also not indicated for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET are difficulty falling/staying asleep, common cold symptoms, sinus infection, diarrhea, indigestion, and/or dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worse.

warnings.details: TRISPER 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in pregnant women during the third trimester period since the medicine might cause side effects such as shaking, muscle stiffness and/or weakness, sleepiness, agitation, breathing problems, and difficulty in feeding in newborn babies. Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.
TRISPER 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.

TRISPER 2MG TABLET might cause dizziness, tiredness, mild nausea, and vision problems. If you experience these side effects, try to avoid driving or operating heavy machines. Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.
TRISPER 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.
TRISPER 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.
TRISPER 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Risperidone or Trihexyphenidyl, or any other ingredients of this medicine.
Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET, if you have heart problems such as irregular heart rhythm.
TRISPER 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.

TRISPER 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). It is not recommended for use in elderly patients suffering from dementia due to stroke. Medical management should be sought straight away if signs of stroke such as sudden change in mental state or sudden weakness or numbness of face, arms or legs, especially on one side, or slurred speech, even for a short period of time are noticed. Consult your doctor before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking TRISPER 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines that work on your brain such as to help you calm down Ex. benzodiazepines
Medicines used for pain such as opiates (Ex. oxycodone, fentanyl, buprenorphine)
Medicines used for allergy such as antihistamines (Ex. brompheniramine, cetirizine, chlorpheniramine)
Medicines that may change the electrical activity of your heart, such as medicines used for malaria, heart rhythm problems (Ex. quinidine), allergies (antihistamines), some antidepressants (Ex. fluoxetine, citalopram, sertraline) or other medicines for mental problems
Medicines that cause a slow heartbeat Ex. amiodarone, flecainide, propafenone
Medicines that cause low blood potassium such as diuretics Ex. chlorthalidone, hydrochlorothiazide, metolazone
Medicines used to manage elevated blood pressure Ex. amlodipine, felodipine, isradipine
Medicines for Parkinson’s disease (brain disorder) Ex. levodopa
Diuretics (medicines used for heart problems or swelling of parts of your body due to a build up of too much fluid) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide
Medicines that increase the activity of the central nervous system such as psychostimulants Ex. methylphenidate
Rifampicin (medicine used for managing some infections) 
Carbamazepine, phenytoin (medicines used for epilepsy)
Phenobarbital (medicine used to control seizures)
Quinidine (medicine used for certain types of heart disease)
Antidepressants (medicines used for depression) Ex. paroxetine, fluoxetine, tricyclic antidepressants
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as beta blockers Ex. atenolol, bisoprolol, carvedilol
Phenothiazines (medicines used to manage psychosis or to calm down) Ex. chlorpromazine, thioridazine, fluphenazine, mesoridazine, perphenazine
Cimetidine, ranitidine (medicines used for stomach acidity)
Itraconazole, ketoconazole (medicines used for managing fungal infections)
Certain medicines used in the management of HIV/AIDS Ex. ritonavir
Verapamil (medicine used to manage high blood pressure and/or abnormal heart rhythm)
Sertraline, fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage depression and other psychiatric disorders)
Aspirin (medicine used for fever and to relieve mild to moderate pain from headaches, toothaches)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used for depression) Ex. moclobemide, tranylcypromine
Disopyramide (medicine used for irregular heartbeat)
Amantadine (medicine used for viral infections)
Nefopam (medicine used as a painkiller)
Metoclopramide or domperidone (medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Parasympathomimetics (medicines used in the management of urinary retention) Ex. neostigmine, bethanechol

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TRISPER 2MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are feeling sleepy or tired, or having abnormal body movements, problems standing and walking, feeling dizzy due to low blood pressure, or having abnormal heartbeats or fits.

introduction:
Introduction About TIDOMET PLUS TABLET

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa and Levodopa which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparkinsonian drugs. It is used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism. Parkinsonism is a long-term illness caused due to loss of nerve cells in the part of the brain which is responsible for producing dopamine. Dopamine is a chemical messenger that controls body balance and movements.

Symptoms of parkinsonism include slow and unsteady movements, muscle tightness, shaking or trembling, difficulty in walking, balance and coordination.

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET must be used with caution among patients having any form of glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes), as it can lead to further damage to the eye. TIDOMET PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

It is important for caregivers to notice and report doctor immediately that if the patient develops any addictive symptoms like craving for large doses of TIDOMET PLUS TABLET, unusual behavior, gambling, excessive eating or spending, an abnormally high sex drive or any other activities that could harm themselves or others.

Try to avoid eating a heavy meal that includes a lot of protein (such as beef, pork, cheese, fish and eggs) while taking TIDOMET PLUS TABLET, as it may interfere with its absorption.

The common side effects of taking TIDOMET PLUS TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abnormal muscle movements, loss of appetite, dry mouth, bitter taste and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism

Uses Of TIDOMET PLUS TABLET
Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism
mechanismOfAction:
How TIDOMET PLUS TABLET Works

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET effectively controls the signs of parkinsonism, where levodopa acts by converting itself into a substance called dopamine (a chemical messenger that controls body movement) and carbidopa acts by managing the breakdown of levodopa outside the brain, thereby allowing greater proportion of levodopa to enter the brain. Collectively they supplement the brain with sufficient dopamine levels which ultimately results in improving the signs of parkinsonism.
usageDetails:
How to use TIDOMET PLUS TABLET

Take TIDOMET PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Continue to take TIDOMET PLUS TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop because sudden withdrawal of TIDOMET PLUS TABLET can cause symptoms like mental changes, fever and muscle tightness.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TIDOMET PLUS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines, as TIDOMET PLUS TABLET may cause sudden sleep attacks or can make you feel sleepy suddenly.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TIDOMET PLUS TABLET, as it could make you feel dizzier or drowsier.
TIDOMET PLUS TABLET should be taken with caution among patients who have or had any kidney diseases in the past. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TIDOMET PLUS TABLET should be taken with caution among patients who have or had any liver diseases in the past. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Talk to your doctor if you are allergic to Levodopa or Carbidopa.

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET should be taken with caution among patients with heart disease (such as previous history of heart attack, heartbeat problems, circulation or breathing problems). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who:

Have ever had any forms of skin cancer
Have any unusual moles in the skin that has not yet been examined by the doctor
Have narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
Have a severe mental disorder (Ex. severe panic disorder, psychosis, severe depression, bipolar disorder)

Before taking TIDOMET PLUS TABLET, inform your physician if you:

Have a history of fits (epilepsy)
Have had an ulcer in the stomach
Have vomited blood
Have any hormonal problems
Have had depression or any other similar mental problems
Have chronic wide-angle glaucoma (a painless eye condition that can affect your vision)
Feel sleepy or having sudden sleep attacks (Ex. Narcolepsy)
Are due to have a surgery
Are due to have a blood/urine test

Use in pediatrics:

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

TIDOMET PLUS TABLET is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, proper dose adjustment and careful monitoring is required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET

CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET contains cabergoline, which belongs to the group of medicines called dopamine agonists. Dopamine is a chemical produced naturally in the body that helps transmit messages to the brain. Cabergoline works by blocking the release of prolactin hormone in the brain and controlling symptoms associated with hormonal disturbances.

CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, stiff and inflamed heart valves (cardiac valvulopathy) and uncontrolled high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pain in the chest while breathing, fluid in the lungs, inflammation or infection of the lungs, reduced liver function, kidney problems, cardiovascular diseases, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children under 16 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET are drowsiness, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo, stomach pain, indigestion, inflamed stomach lining, fatigue, lack of bodily strength, weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Blocks the release of prolactin hormone in the brain

Blocks the release of prolactin hormone in the brain
mechanismOfAction:
How CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET Works

CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET works by decreasing the amount of a hormone called prolactin (a hormone that is responsible for milk production and breast tissue development).
usageDetails:
How to use CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET

Take CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

It can be taken with or after food to help reduce feelings of nausea or vomiting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. You should not stop taking CABERLACT 0.25MG TABLET until your doctor tells you.

introduction:
Introduction About ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET

ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa, Levodopa and Entacapone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parkinsonian drugs. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson's disease is a disorder affecting the brain, causing unintended or uncontrollable movements, such as shaking, stiffness and difficulty along with balance and coordination. It usually starts gradually and worsens over time. As the disease progresses, people have difficulty walking and talking.

While taking ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET for the long term, your doctor may suggest some regular laboratory tests. ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, narrow-angle glaucoma, adrenal gland tumour, history of neuroleptic malignant syndrome and non-traumatic rhabdomyolysis.

Before taking ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other disease of the lungs, kidney, heart and mental health diseases. ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding, children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The common side effects of ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET are uncontrolled movements, nausea, reddish-brown, discoloured urine, diarrhoea and muscle pain. If any of these become worse, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET
Manage Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET Works

ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET is a combination of Levodopa which gets converted to dopamine, a chemical messenger that controls movement in the brain. Carbidopa manages the breakdown of Levodopa by allowing it to enter the brain for increased dopamine levels and Entacapone maintains the level of levodopa in the blood. All these collective actions provide greater relief from the symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.

Take ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decided by your doctor, depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENTACOM PLUS 100MG TABLET without your doctor’s advice.

name: LCD 125 Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LCD 125 TABLET

LCD 125 Tablet is a prescription medicine commonly used to help manage Parkinson’s disease and related movement disorders. These conditions occur due to low levels of dopamine, a brain chemical that controls smooth and coordinated muscle activity. The tablet contains Levodopa (100 mg) and Carbidopa (25 mg), a well-researched combination that helps restore dopamine balance and improve motor function. It assists in reducing symptoms such as muscle stiffness, tremors, slowness of movement, and loss of coordination, allowing better control over daily activities. 

LCD 125 Tablet is ideal for patients experiencing motor symptoms of Parkinson’s disease or secondary Parkinsonism. It works by converting Levodopa into dopamine in the brain, while Carbidopa prevents its breakdown before reaching the brain ensuring maximum effectiveness with fewer side effects. The tablet helps enhance movement, steadiness, and flexibility, improving overall quality of life when taken regularly under medical supervision.    

It should be taken as directed by your doctor, usually 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals for best absorption. Swallow the tablet whole with water and try to take it at the same time daily. Avoid taking it with high-protein meals as they may reduce absorption. Patients should not stop the medicine suddenly without consulting a doctor, as it may worsen symptoms. Caution is advised in people with heart problems, liver or kidney disease, or glaucoma.     

During pregnancy and breastfeeding, LCD 125 Tablet should be used only if clearly needed and prescribed by a healthcare professional. Common side effects may include nausea, dizziness, dry mouth, or sleep disturbances, which are generally mild and manageable. Regular follow-ups with your doctor are important to monitor progress and adjust the dose if necessary.

mechanismOfAction:
How LCD 125 TABLET Works
Mechanism of Action of LCD 125 Tablet

LCD 125 Tablet works by restoring the balance of dopamine in the brain, which is essential for smooth and controlled muscle movements. It contains two key ingredients Levodopa and Carbidopa that function together to enhance effectiveness and reduce side effects.

Levodopa: Once inside the body, Levodopa is converted into dopamine in the brain. This helps improve communication between nerve cells, reducing symptoms such as stiffness, tremors, and slowness of movement.
Carbidopa: Carbidopa prevents Levodopa from being broken down before it reaches the brain. This ensures more Levodopa is available for conversion into dopamine and helps minimize side effects like nausea or vomiting.

Together, these ingredients help increase dopamine activity, improving movement coordination, muscle control, and overall motor function in individuals with Parkinson’s disease and related disorders.
usageInstructions: Take exactly as prescribed: Always take LCD 125 Tablet in the dose and duration recommended by your doctor. Do not change or stop the dose on your own.
Timing of intake: It is usually taken 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals for better absorption, unless advised otherwise by your healthcare provider.
Swallow whole with water: Do not crush, chew, or break the tablet. Swallow it whole with a glass of water.
Maintain regular timing: Take the tablet at the same time every day to maintain a steady level of medicine in your body.
Avoid high-protein meals around dosing: Protein-rich foods (like meat, eggs, or cheese) can interfere with Levodopa absorption, so try to take the tablet apart from such meals.
Do not stop suddenly: Stopping LCD 125 Tablet suddenly may worsen symptoms. Always consult your doctor before making any changes.
If you miss a dose: Take it as soon as you remember. If it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed one don’t double up to make up for it.

warnings.details: LCD 125 Tablet should be used during pregnancy only if your healthcare provider finds it necessary. If it is prescribed, your doctor may monitor foetal growth and maternal health throughout the course. If any unwanted effects are observed in the mother or baby, alternative options may be considered. Always inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning pregnancy before starting this medicine.

LCD 125 Tablet may pass into breast milk in small quantities. The concentration of the medicine in milk can be influenced by its level in the bloodstream. Therefore, breastfeeding while taking LCD 125 Tablet is generally not recommended. Discuss with your healthcare provider about safer alternatives if you are a nursing mother.

Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you understand how LCD 125 Tablet affects your focus or coordination. Some individuals may experience dizziness or tiredness, which could impair attention.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LCD 125 Tablet, as it could make you feel dizzier or drowsier.

LCD 125 Tablet should be used cautiously in patients with kidney disorders. Dose adjustments or frequent monitoring of kidney function may be required. Inform your doctor about any history of kidney problems before starting this medicine.

Patients with liver impairment should take LCD 125 Tablet under close medical supervision. Your doctor may recommend routine liver function tests to ensure safe use. Always share any known liver issues with your healthcare provider before use.

Do not take LCD 125 Tablet if you are allergic to any of its active ingredients or excipients. Report any signs of allergic reactions such as rash, itching, swelling, or difficulty breathing to your doctor immediately.

If you have chronic lung conditions or breathing difficulties, inform your doctor before taking LCD 125 Tablet. Some individuals with respiratory issues may require dose adjustments or special monitoring.

Patients with existing heart conditions should use LCD 125 Tablet only under medical advice. Inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure, irregular heartbeat, or a history of heart disease. Regular monitoring of heart rate and blood pressure may be necessary.
LCD 125 Tablet is not recommended for children or adolescents as its safety and effectiveness in this age group have not been established.

Elderly patients may require lower starting doses of LCD 125 Tablet, which can be gradually increased under close medical supervision. Regular monitoring of organ function and response to the medicine is advised to ensure safety.

name: PARKITIDIN ER 193 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET

PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET contains Amantadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists or Anti-viral agents. It is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease (a progressive nervous disease that causes tremor, muscular rigidity and slow imprecise movements), and manages various strains of influenza A virus (caused by the multiplication of the virus inside the body).

It is also used to manage shingles (herpes zoster) to reduce pain, which is a reactivation of chickenpox virus causing a painful rash and drug-induced extrapyramidal reactions (such as involuntary muscle contraction, tremors, stiff muscles, and involuntary facial movements caused by antipsychotics and other drugs).

Before taking PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver or heart (which may cause shortness of breath or ankle swelling), any mental illness like schizophrenia (mental disorder) or dementia (memory loss) and glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes).

PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET is not recommended to be taken while you are pregnant or breast feeding. PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET is not recommended for use in newborn and infants (below 1 year of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (who are 65 years of age or older). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET are loss of appetite, tiredness, dryness in the mouth, constipation and nausea or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET Works

PARKITIDIN ER 193 TABLET is a dopamine agonist and an anti-viral agent that manages Parkinson's disease and certain type of viral infections. As a dopamine agonist, it works by increasing the amount of dopamine, a chemical messenger in the brain which regulates the body movements. As an antiviral agent, it works against viruses to prevent their growth and multiplication. It also stops the viruses from releasing infectious chemicals (viral nucleic acid) to enter into the body which protects from influenza infection.

Others

Ever had ulcer in the stomach or small intestine

introduction:
Introduction About TIDOMET LS TABLET

TIDOMET LS TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa and Levodopa which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparkinsonian drugs. It is used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism. Parkinsonism is a long-term illness caused due to loss of nerve cells in the part of the brain which is responsible for producing dopamine. Dopamine is a chemical messenger that controls body balance and movements.

Symptoms of parkinsonism include slow and unsteady movements, muscle tightness, shaking or trembling, difficulty in walking, balance and coordination.

TIDOMET LS TABLET must be used with caution among patients having any form of glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes), as it can lead to further damage to the eye. TIDOMET LS TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

It is important for caregivers to notice and report doctor immediately that if the patient develops any addictive symptoms like craving for large doses of TIDOMET LS TABLET, unusual behavior, gambling, excessive eating or spending, an abnormally high sex drive or any other activities that could harm themselves or others.

Try to avoid eating a heavy meal that includes a lot of protein (such as beef, pork, cheese, fish and eggs) while taking TIDOMET LS TABLET, as it may interfere with its absorption.

The common side effects of taking TIDOMET LS TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abnormal muscle movements, loss of appetite, dry mouth, bitter taste and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Collectively they supplement the brain with sufficient dopamine levels which ultimately results in improving the signs of parkinsonism.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TIDOMET LS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MODIN 5MG TABLET

MODIN 5MG TABLET contains Procyclidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics. It is used to relieve and manage the signs of Parkinson's disease such as stiff muscles, paralysis, shaking of hands (tremors), trouble talking, writing and walking, producing too much saliva and dribbling, sweating, uncontrolled eye movements and depression.

MODIN 5MG TABLET is also used to control extrapyramidal effects caused by certain medicines used to manage mental health conditions, which might include restlessness and unusual head and body movements.

MODIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have tardive dyskinesia (uncontrolled movements of the head or tongue). Consult your doctor before taking it.

MODIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease, high blood pressure, heart disease, glaucoma, thyrotoxicosis. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MODIN 5MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Inform your doctor if you are breastfeeding before taking it.

MODIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. MODIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking MODIN 5MG TABLET are dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty urinating. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MODIN 5MG TABLET Works

MODIN 5MG TABLET works by stopping a substance called acetylcholine in the brain and helps to reduce the symptoms of Parkinson's disease such as muscle stiffness, sweating, production of saliva and improves walking ability in people with Parkinson’s disease and also helps to controls Parkinson-like side effects caused by certain medicines used to manage mental health conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use MODIN 5MG TABLET

Take MODIN 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take it with food to reduce nausea. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MODIN 5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop. Otherwise, your symptoms may return.

name: LCD 250 CR Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About LCD 250 CR TABLET

LCD 250 CR TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa and Levodopa which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparkinsonian drugs. It is used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism. Parkinsonism is a long-term illness caused due to loss of nerve cells in the part of the brain which is responsible for producing dopamine. Dopamine is a chemical messenger that controls body balance and movements.

Symptoms of parkinsonism include slow and unsteady movements, muscle tightness, shaking or trembling, difficulty in walking, balance and coordination.

LCD 250 CR TABLET must be used with caution among patients having any form of glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes), as it can lead to further damage to the eye. LCD 250 CR TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

It is important for caregivers to notice and report doctor immediately that if the patient develops any addictive symptoms like craving for large doses of LCD 250 CR TABLET, unusual behavior, gambling, excessive eating or spending, an abnormally high sex drive or any other activities that could harm themselves or others.

Try to avoid eating a heavy meal that includes a lot of protein (such as beef, pork, cheese, fish and eggs) while taking LCD 250 CR TABLET, as it may interfere with its absorption.

The common side effects of taking LCD 250 CR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abnormal muscle movements, loss of appetite, dry mouth, bitter taste and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism
usesDetails:
Uses Of LCD 250 CR TABLET
Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism
mechanismOfAction:
How LCD 250 CR TABLET Works

LCD 250 CR TABLET effectively controls the signs of parkinsonism, where levodopa acts by converting itself into a substance called dopamine (a chemical messenger that controls body movement) and carbidopa acts by managing the breakdown of levodopa outside the brain, thereby allowing greater proportion of levodopa to enter the brain. Collectively they supplement the brain with sufficient dopamine levels which ultimately results in improving the signs of parkinsonism.
usageDetails:
How to use LCD 250 CR TABLET

Take LCD 250 CR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Continue to take LCD 250 CR TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop because sudden withdrawal of LCD 250 CR TABLET can cause symptoms like mental changes, fever and muscle tightness.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LCD 250 CR TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

LCD 250 CR TABLET is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, proper dose adjustment and careful monitoring is required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET

PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET Works

PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

Take PRAMIROL 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET

CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET contains cabergoline, which belongs to the group of medicines called dopamine agonists. Dopamine is a chemical produced naturally in the body that helps transmit messages to the brain. Cabergoline works by blocking the release of prolactin hormone in the brain and controlling symptoms associated with hormonal disturbances.

CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, stiff and inflamed heart valves (cardiac valvulopathy) and uncontrolled high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pain in the chest while breathing, fluid in the lungs, inflammation or infection of the lungs, reduced liver function, kidney problems, cardiovascular diseases, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children under 16 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET are drowsiness, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo, stomach pain, indigestion, inflamed stomach lining, fatigue, lack of bodily strength, weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET Works

CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET works by decreasing the amount of a hormone called prolactin (a hormone that is responsible for milk production and breast tissue development).

Take CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

It can be taken with or after food to help reduce feelings of nausea or vomiting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. You should not stop taking CB LIN 0.5MG TABLET until your doctor tells you.

name: SAFION 100 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About SAFION 100 TABLET

SAFION 100 TABLET contains Safinamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoamine oxidase type B (MAO-B) inhibitors. SAFION 100 TABLET is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease, which is an age-related degenerative brain condition that cause unintended/uncontrollable movements in adults.

SAFION 100 TABLET is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease in mid-late-stage patients when used with Levodopa or in combination with other anti-Parkinson’s disease. 

SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Safinamide. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from eye condition (due to albinism, retinal degeneration, uveitis, inherited retinopathy), and/or severe liver problems.

Before taking SAFION 100 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or other liver problems (such as mild to moderate hepatic impairment).

SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking SAFION 100 TABLET are insomnia (sleeplessness), difficulty in performing voluntary movements, feeling sleepy/dizzy/falling, headache, clouding of eye lens, drop in blood pressure (while raising to a standing position), and/or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

SAFION 100 TABLET works by increasing the level of a substance called dopamine (responsible for the control of movement) in the brain which generally occurs in low levels in patient affected with Parkinson’s disease.

warnings.details: SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive measures while taking SAFION 100 TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is likely to be excreted in breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel excess sleepiness/dizzy after taking SAFION 100 TABLET.
SAFION 100 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems such as renal impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SAFION 100 TABLET.

SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use if patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SAFION 100 TABLET.
Do not take SAFION 100 TABLET if you are allergic to Safinamide, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Suffer from eye condition due to albinism (condition marked by lesser pigment in skin and eyes), retinal degeneration (loss of cells from light sensitive layer at the back of the eye), uveitis (inflammation of eye), inherited retinopathy (inherited vision disorders), and/or severe progressive diabetic retinopathy (progressive reduction of vision due to diabetes).

Use in Pediatrics:

SAFION 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of data on safety and efficacy of the medicine. Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child.

Use in Geriatrics:

SAFION 100 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking SAFION 100 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. selegiline, rasagiline, moclobemide, phenelzine, isocarboxazid, tranylcypromine
Pethidine (used to relieve severe pain)
Medicines used to manage cold/cough (Ex. dextromethorphan, ephedrine, pseudoephedrine)
Medicines used to manage anxiety and some personality disorders (Ex. fluoxetine, fluvoxamine)
Medicines used to manage major depression and other mood disorders (Ex. venlafaxine, duloxetine)
Medicines used in high cholesterol (Ex. rosuvastatin, pitavastatin, pravastatin)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. ciprofloxacin)
Medicines that affect the immune system (Ex. methotrexate)
Medicines used to manage metastatic carcinoma (Ex. topotecan)
Medicine used to manage pain and inflammation (Ex. diclofenac)
Medicines used to manage type 2 diabetes (Ex. glyburide, metformin)
Medicines used to manage viral infection (Ex. acyclovir, ganciclovir)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of SAFION 100 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are raised blood pressure, anxiety, confusion, forgetfulness, sleepiness, lightheadedness, nausea, vomiting, dilated pupils, and/or involuntary jerky movements.

name: Cabliz 0.5mg Tablet 2'S
introduction:
Introduction About CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET contains cabergoline, which belongs to the group of medicines called dopamine agonists. Dopamine is a chemical produced naturally in the body that helps transmit messages to the brain. Cabergoline works by blocking the release of prolactin hormone in the brain and controlling symptoms associated with hormonal disturbances.

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, stiff and inflamed heart valves (cardiac valvulopathy) and uncontrolled high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pain in the chest while breathing, fluid in the lungs, inflammation or infection of the lungs, reduced liver function, kidney problems, cardiovascular diseases, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children under 16 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET are drowsiness, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo, stomach pain, indigestion, inflamed stomach lining, fatigue, lack of bodily strength, weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET Works

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET works by decreasing the amount of a hormone called prolactin (a hormone that is responsible for milk production and breast tissue development).
usageDetails:
How to use CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET

Take CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

It can be taken with or after food to help reduce feelings of nausea or vomiting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. You should not stop taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET until your doctor tells you.

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding as this medicine will stop you producing milk for your baby. If you need to take CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET you should use another method of feeding your baby.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy, and sudden sleepy after taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET.
Avoid alcohol consumption while taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET as it increases the risk of dizziness.
CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET.

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with reduced liver function. Contact your doctor before taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET.

Do not take CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Cabergoline or to other medicines called ergot alkaloids (Ex. pergolide, bromocriptine, lisuride, ergotamine or ergometrine) or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine (lactose).

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pain in the chest while breathing, fluid in the lungs, inflammation or infection of the lungs. Consult your doctor before taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET.
CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with stiff and inflamed heart valves (cardiac valvulopathy) and uncontrolled high blood pressure.
CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children under 16 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

History of mental illness associated with childbirth (puerperal psychosis)
Fibrotic reactions (scar tissue) affecting the abdomen, heart or lungs
Swelling of hands and feet and a high blood pressure during pregnancy (preeclampsia, eclampsia)

Before taking CABLIZ 0.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Cold hands and feet (Raynaud’s syndrome)
Peptic ulcer or GI haemorrhage (bleeding from the stomach and intestines)
History of serious mental disease (psychotic disorders)
Just given birth you may be more at risk of certain conditions like high blood pressure, convulsion, stroke or mental health problems
Increased blood pressure after giving birth

name: Pexopram 0.125mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET

PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET Works

PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).
usageDetails:
How to use PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET

Take PEXOPRAM 0.125MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIROL SR

PRAMIROL SR contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIROL SR should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIROL SR is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIROL SR include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIROL SR
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIROL SR Works

PRAMIROL SR is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

Take PRAMIROL SR as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: LCD 275mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LCD 275MG TABLET

LCD 275MG TABLET is a combination of Carbidopa and Levodopa which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparkinsonian drugs. It is used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism. Parkinsonism is a long-term illness caused due to loss of nerve cells in the part of the brain which is responsible for producing dopamine. Dopamine is a chemical messenger that controls body balance and movements.

Symptoms of parkinsonism include slow and unsteady movements, muscle tightness, shaking or trembling, difficulty in walking, balance and coordination.

LCD 275MG TABLET must be used with caution among patients having any form of glaucoma (increased pressure in the eyes), as it can lead to further damage to the eye. LCD 275MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

It is important for caregivers to notice and report doctor immediately that if the patient develops any addictive symptoms like craving for large doses of LCD 275MG TABLET, unusual behavior, gambling, excessive eating or spending, an abnormally high sex drive or any other activities that could harm themselves or others.

Try to avoid eating a heavy meal that includes a lot of protein (such as beef, pork, cheese, fish and eggs) while taking LCD 275MG TABLET, as it may interfere with its absorption.

The common side effects of taking LCD 275MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, abnormal muscle movements, loss of appetite, dry mouth, bitter taste and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism
usesDetails:
Uses Of LCD 275MG TABLET
Used to improve the signs of Parkinsonism
mechanismOfAction:
How LCD 275MG TABLET Works

LCD 275MG TABLET effectively controls the signs of parkinsonism, where levodopa acts by converting itself into a substance called dopamine (a chemical messenger that controls body movement) and carbidopa acts by managing the breakdown of levodopa outside the brain, thereby allowing greater proportion of levodopa to enter the brain. Collectively they supplement the brain with sufficient dopamine levels which ultimately results in improving the signs of parkinsonism.
usageDetails:
How to use LCD 275MG TABLET

Take LCD 275MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Continue to take LCD 275MG TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop because sudden withdrawal of LCD 275MG TABLET can cause symptoms like mental changes, fever and muscle tightness.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LCD 275MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LCD 275MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage depression (such as isocarboxazid, phenelzine, selegiline, tranylcypromine)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, isoniazid)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, captopril, enalapril, olmesartan, telmisartan)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, valproic acid, phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage involuntary movements (such as ataxia, dystonia, myoclonus, tardive dyskinesia) Ex. fluphenazine, haloperidol, chlorpromazine or thioridazine
