Papaverine (a medicine used to manage impotence in men)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Try to avoid eating a heavy meal that includes a lot of protein (such as beef, pork, fish and eggs) while taking LCD 275MG TABLET, as it may interfere with its absorption.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of LCD 275MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away.

introduction:
Introduction About MIRATOR 0.125MG TABLET

MIRATOR 0.125MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

MIRATOR 0.125MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. MIRATOR 0.125MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking MIRATOR 0.125MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease

mechanismOfAction:
How MIRATOR 0.125MG TABLET Works

MIRATOR 0.125MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

introduction:
Introduction About PARKINTA 2MG TABLET

PARKINTA 2MG TABLET contains Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to the group of medicines called Central Anticholinergics. It is used to improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson’s disease is a long-term brain disorder that causes muscle stiffness, shaking, slow and unsteady movements, difficulty in walking and loss of balance. It happens due to loss of nerve cells at certain regions of brain (basal ganglia) that controls body movements.

PARKINTA 2MG TABLET can also be used to control abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms) in the body that is caused due to the use of certain medicines.

Trihexyphenidyl is a muscle relaxant. It reduces muscle stiffness and relaxes muscles by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also restores a balance between certain brain chemicals (dopamine and acetylcholine) that controls body movements.

Before taking PARKINTA 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or problems in your prostate gland. You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems before taking PARKINTA 2MG TABLET as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking PARKINTA 2MG TABLET if you have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or tardive dyskinesia (unusual movements of face and tongue). Consult your doctor before taking PARKINTA 2MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking PARKINTA 2MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, blurred vision, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

PARKINTA 2MG TABLET is an anticholinergic medicine with muscle relaxing properties. It reduces muscle stiffness and improves muscle control by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also regulates the release of a brain chemical called dopamine that regulates proper body movements and coordination. As a result, it reduces abnormal muscle movements associated with Parkinson’s disease and with the use of certain medicines.

name: Adrole 0.25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET

ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (unintentional urge to move the legs)

mechanismOfAction:
How ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET Works

ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.
usageDetails:
How to use ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET

Take ADROLE 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET

PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET Works

PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

Take PRAMIRISE 0.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ROPARIL 2MG TABLET

ROPARIL 2MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPARIL 2MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPARIL 2MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPARIL 2MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPARIL 2MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPARIL 2MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Manage Parkinson’s Disease (signs include shakiness, abnormal body movements, loss of balance)
Manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (unintentional urge to move the legs)

mechanismOfAction:
How ROPARIL 2MG TABLET Works

ROPARIL 2MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.
usageDetails:
How to use ROPARIL 2MG TABLET

Take ROPARIL 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TRI EX 2MG TABLET

TRI EX 2MG TABLET contains Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to the group of medicines called Central Anticholinergics. It is used to improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson’s disease is a long-term brain disorder that causes muscle stiffness, shaking, slow and unsteady movements, difficulty in walking and loss of balance. It happens due to loss of nerve cells at certain regions of brain (basal ganglia) that controls body movements.

TRI EX 2MG TABLET can also be used to control abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms) in the body that is caused due to the use of certain medicines.

Trihexyphenidyl is a muscle relaxant. It reduces muscle stiffness and relaxes muscles by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also restores a balance between certain brain chemicals (dopamine and acetylcholine) that controls body movements.

Before taking TRI EX 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or problems in your prostate gland. You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems before taking TRI EX 2MG TABLET as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking TRI EX 2MG TABLET if you have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or tardive dyskinesia (unusual movements of face and tongue). Consult your doctor before taking TRI EX 2MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking TRI EX 2MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, blurred vision, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage drug-induced abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms)

How TRI EX 2MG TABLET Works

TRI EX 2MG TABLET is an anticholinergic medicine with muscle relaxing properties. It reduces muscle stiffness and improves muscle control by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also regulates the release of a brain chemical called dopamine that regulates proper body movements and coordination. As a result, it reduces abnormal muscle movements associated with Parkinson’s disease and with the use of certain medicines.

Take TRI EX 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow TRI EX 2MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine. It must be taken with or just before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take TRI EX 2MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as advised by your doctor without any interruption to achieve maximum benefits.

name: ZAFIMOVE 100 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET contains Safinamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoamine oxidase type B (MAO-B) inhibitors. ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is used in the management of Parkinson’s disease, which is an age-related degenerative brain condition that cause unintended/uncontrollable movements in adults.

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease in mid-late-stage patients when used with Levodopa or in combination with other anti-Parkinson’s disease. 

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Safinamide. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from eye condition (due to albinism, retinal degeneration, uveitis, inherited retinopathy), and/or severe liver problems.

Before taking ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or other liver problems (such as mild to moderate hepatic impairment).

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET are insomnia (sleeplessness), difficulty in performing voluntary movements, feeling sleepy/dizzy/falling, headache, clouding of eye lens, drop in blood pressure (while raising to a standing position), and/or nausea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is likely to be excreted in breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel excess sleepiness/dizzy after taking ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET.
ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems such as renal impairment. Consult your doctor before taking ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET.

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use if patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET.
Do not take ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET if you are allergic to Safinamide, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Suffer from eye condition due to albinism (condition marked by lesser pigment in skin and eyes), retinal degeneration (loss of cells from light sensitive layer at the back of the eye), uveitis (inflammation of eye), inherited retinopathy (inherited vision disorders), and/or severe progressive diabetic retinopathy (progressive reduction of vision due to diabetes).

Use in Pediatrics:

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of data on safety and efficacy of the medicine. Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child.

Use in Geriatrics:

ZAFIMOVE 100 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET

CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET contains cabergoline, which belongs to the group of medicines called dopamine agonists. Dopamine is a chemical produced naturally in the body that helps transmit messages to the brain. Cabergoline works by blocking the release of prolactin hormone in the brain and controlling symptoms associated with hormonal disturbances.

CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease, stiff and inflamed heart valves (cardiac valvulopathy) and uncontrolled high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pain in the chest while breathing, fluid in the lungs, inflammation or infection of the lungs, reduced liver function, kidney problems, cardiovascular diseases, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children under 16 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects after taking CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET are drowsiness, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo, stomach pain, indigestion, inflamed stomach lining, fatigue, lack of bodily strength, weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET Works

CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET works by decreasing the amount of a hormone called prolactin (a hormone that is responsible for milk production and breast tissue development).
usageDetails:
How to use CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET

Take CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

It can be taken with or after food to help reduce feelings of nausea or vomiting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. You should not stop taking CABLIZ 0.25MG TABLET until your doctor tells you.

Increased blood pressure after giving birth

introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET

PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET Works

PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

Take PRAMIROL 1.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET

APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET contains Apomorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage erectile dysfunction in men which occurs due to inability to achieve and sustain an erection during sexual intercourse which is generally characterized by symptoms such as reduced sexual desire, low self-esteem, depression and distress in affected men.

APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Apomorphine. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as severe chest pain, recent heart attack and severe heart failure) and severe low blood pressure.  

It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases (such as hepatic insufficiency) and kidney diseases (such as mild, moderate or severe renal insufficiency).

This medicine is not recommended for use in women, children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years).  

The common side effects associated with the use of APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flushing, indigestion and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Manage erectile dysfunction in men
usesDetails:
Uses Of APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET
Manage erectile dysfunction in men
mechanismOfAction:
How APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET Works

APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET works by acting as an agonist to dopamine (a neurotransmitter) which enhance its action by binding to the selective dopamine receptors in the brain that leads to stimulation of brain region which controls motor actions in the penis thus resulting in managing erectile dysfunction in affected men during sexual intercourse.
usageDetails:
How to use APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET

Take APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET as advised by your physician. Drink a small amount of water before taking the medicine to optimise the dissolution of the medicine.

Place the medicine under the tongue to get it dissolved completely (usually takes 10 minutes), approximately 20 minutes prior to sexual activity. Do not crush or chew the medicine. If any residue remains in the mouth even after 20 minutes, it may be swallowed.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and general health condition.

APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe unstable angina (chest pain), recent heart attack, and/or severe heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET.

Others

APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe hypotension (low blood pressure)
Have other medical conditions that could make sexual activity dangerous

Before taking APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET inform your doctor if you:  

Have spinal cord injuries or multiple sclerosis (potential disease of the brain and spinal cord)
Had undergone prostatectomy (removal of complete or a part of prostate gland) or pelvic surgery
Have diabetes
Have anatomical penile deformity conditions such as angulation, cavernosal fibrosis, or Peyronie’s disease
Have uncontrolled high blood pressure
Have a history of postural hypotension (low blood pressure that occurs while standing up from sitting or lying down position)

Use in pediatrics:

APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

APOTAB 2 SUBLINGUAL TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: TEXY 2MG TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TEXY 2MG TABLET

TEXY 2MG TABLET contains Trihexyphenidyl which belongs to the group of medicines called Central Anticholinergics. It is used to improve muscle control in patients with Parkinson’s disease. Parkinson’s disease is a long-term brain disorder that causes muscle stiffness, shaking, slow and unsteady movements, difficulty in walking and loss of balance. It happens due to loss of nerve cells at certain regions of brain (basal ganglia) that controls body movements.

TEXY 2MG TABLET can also be used to control abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms) in the body that is caused due to the use of certain medicines.

Trihexyphenidyl is a muscle relaxant. It reduces muscle stiffness and relaxes muscles by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also restores a balance between certain brain chemicals (dopamine and acetylcholine) that controls body movements.

Before taking TEXY 2MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high blood pressure, stomach ulcer or problems in your prostate gland. You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems before taking TEXY 2MG TABLET as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking TEXY 2MG TABLET if you have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or tardive dyskinesia (unusual movements of face and tongue). Consult your doctor before taking TEXY 2MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking TEXY 2MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, dizziness, blurred vision, nausea, and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage drug-induced abnormal involuntary muscle movements (such as extreme restlessness or muscle spasms)

How TEXY 2MG TABLET Works

TEXY 2MG TABLET is an anticholinergic medicine with muscle relaxing properties. It reduces muscle stiffness and improves muscle control by reducing the activity of a chemical messenger called acetylcholine in the brain. It also regulates the release of a brain chemical called dopamine that regulates proper body movements and coordination. As a result, it reduces abnormal muscle movements associated with Parkinson’s disease and with the use of certain medicines.

Take TEXY 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow TEXY 2MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine. It must be taken with or just before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take TEXY 2MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as advised by your doctor without any interruption to achieve maximum benefits.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET

ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET contains Apomorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage erectile dysfunction in men which occurs due to inability to achieve and sustain an erection during sexual intercourse which is generally characterized by symptoms such as reduced sexual desire, low self-esteem, depression and distress in affected men.

ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Apomorphine. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as severe chest pain, recent heart attack and severe heart failure) and severe low blood pressure.  

It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases (such as hepatic insufficiency) and kidney diseases (such as mild, moderate or severe renal insufficiency).

This medicine is not recommended for use in women, children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years).  

The common side effects associated with the use of ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flushing, indigestion and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Manage erectile dysfunction in men
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET
Manage erectile dysfunction in men
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET Works

ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET works by acting as an agonist to dopamine (a neurotransmitter) which enhance its action by binding to the selective dopamine receptors in the brain that leads to stimulation of brain region which controls motor actions in the penis thus resulting in managing erectile dysfunction in affected men during sexual intercourse.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET

Take ZYPRIMA 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Drink a small amount of water before taking the medicine to optimise the dissolution of the medicine.

Place the medicine under the tongue to get it dissolved completely (usually takes 10 minutes), approximately 20 minutes prior to sexual activity. Do not crush or chew the medicine. If any residue remains in the mouth even after 20 minutes, it may be swallowed.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and general health condition.

name: ROPIKON 0.25 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET

ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET Works

ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.

Take ROPIKON 0.25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.
